carousel.title: Ontario Revives Regional Immigration Pathway for Sudbury, Thunder Bay, Nipissing and Kenora
carousel.excerpt: The relaunched REDI initiative reserves Ontario nomination spaces for workers in six northern and rural communities until December 31, 2027. Quotas are not yet published, and the Workforce Priority Stream is currently the only active OINP route.
carousel.image_caption: Sudbury, Ontario, one of the communities covered by Ontario's revived regional immigration pathway.
carousel.nri_angle: A concrete route for Indian workers and graduates in Canada willing to settle outside the GTA, where nomination spaces are reserved by community rather than competed for province-wide.

carousel.title: Delhi's AQI Leaps From 65 to 216 in a Day as Calm Weather Traps Pollution
carousel.excerpt: Friday's rain briefly gave the capital satisfactory air. With the IMD forecasting dry, still days ahead, the winter pollution season has arrived early — and GRAP Stage 1 is already in force.
carousel.image_caption: South Block is engulfed in a layer of smog in New Delhi. Delhi's AQI jumped from 65 to 216 in a day as dry, calm weather trapped pollutants over the capital.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora families flying into Delhi for Diwali face AQI swings from 65 to 216 within a day; morning AQI checks and masks for sensitive travellers are now part of the trip.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Jailer 2 Crosses ₹209 Crore Worldwide in Two Days, Eyes a Record Weekend
carousel.excerpt: A 38% day-two drop counts as a phenomenal hold for a Rajinikanth opener. With Dussehra holidays ahead, trade trackers say ₹500 crore by midweek is in play.
carousel.image_caption: Rajinikanth leads the Jailer 2 poster artwork, flanked by Mohanlal and Shiva Rajkumar. The sequel crossed ₹209 crore worldwide in its first two days in theatres.
carousel.nri_angle: Nearly half the worldwide gross is from overseas markets, underlining the North America and Gulf diaspora's weight in Kollywood's biggest openings.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Mumbai Indians Part Ways With Coach Mahela Jayawardene After Ninth-Place Finish
carousel.excerpt: The five-time champions and their three-title coach agreed to split in search of a 'fresh perspective', with interviews for a successor expected in the coming week.
carousel.image_caption: Mahela Jayawardene directs a Mumbai Indians training session in team colours. MI and Jayawardene mutually parted ways on October 17 after the five-time champions finished ninth in IPL 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: Mumbai Indians are among the most-watched IPL franchises in the US, Gulf and Australian diaspora; a new coach shapes the squad those fans will follow in 2027.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Wipro's Deal Bookings Hit a Near Four-Year Low, Testing Its AI Growth Story
carousel.excerpt: Large-deal wins plunged 58.6% to $674 million in the September quarter. Management says two awarded deals simply missed the signature deadline — Q3 will decide whether investors believe that.
carousel.image_caption: A Wipro sign stands outside a company office building. Wipro's large-deal bookings fell 58.6% to $674 million in the September quarter, a near four-year low.
carousel.nri_angle: Wipro employs tens of thousands in the US and its deal pipeline shapes H-1B and onsite hiring demand across the Indian IT sector.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: White House Touts $330 Billion in Indian Investment as 'Trillions Pour In'
carousel.excerpt: Two India entries — a $300 billion Reliance refinery partnership and $20.5 billion in SelectUSA pledges — put India among America's largest announced investors, though a second White House tracker counts $500 billion.
carousel.image_caption: The White House in Washington, DC. The White House's investment showcase lists $330.5 billion in India-linked commitments, including a $300 billion Reliance refinery partnership.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian corporates are now listed by the White House alongside Gulf-scale investors in the US — a marker of how central India-linked capital has become to the US industrial push.
